market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Bullish. The sideways action over the last week has resolved to the upside. The Nasdaq is now less than 1% away from the 27,000 round number and new high territory. The S&P 500 and equal-weight indexes are already at new highs. The market is optimistic despite geopolitical and economic headwinds, which is a sign of strength. The advice: continue to follow the price/volume action and focus on individual leaders.

ASML.technical_action: Reclaimed the 50-day line, now forming the right side of a base, less than 8% from all-time highs. RS line improving.
ASML.story: Institutional-quality chip equipment leader (EUV lithography). The strongest looking of the mega-cap chip equipment names.

IGV.technical_action: Breakout on a 3% gain, making a clear upward move.
IGV.story: Software ETF. The sector is now outperforming after lagging yesterday; a broad technology move.

APMD.technical_action: Recent July 31st IPO, up only two days since going public. Forming a high, tight IPO base. Reversed higher today.
APMD.story: Speculative biotech. A first-of-its-kind pill for sleep apnea. FDA approval (NDA) expected decision February 2027. No revenue yet.

FDX.technical_action: Carving the right side of a cup base, moved up 4% today, near the $340 breakout level. Volume increasing.
FDX.story: Blue-chip logistics leader. Executing on multi-billion dollar cost-cutting campaign, with improvements in earnings and revenue.

AEHR.technical_action: Explosive two-week rally, then a 4% pullback today. This is a "bullish 4% decline" after such a strong move. Still near highs.
AEHR.story: Chip equipment (burn-in testing). A leader in the group that's held up well.

AMAT.technical_action: Down 3.5% after earnings. Has been hitting resistance at the 50-day line for several weeks and is struggling to break above it.
AMAT.story: Applied Materials. An 800-lb gorilla in chip equipment that is lagging the recovery; earnings reaction failed.

LRCX.technical_action: Similar to AMAT, trying to reclaim the 50-day line but hasn't decisively cleared it.
LRCX.story: Lam Research. Another mega-cap chip equipment laggard; improving but not a leader.

KLAC.technical_action: Similar to AMAT, has not even reached the 50-day line yet.
KLAC.story: KLA Corp. Another widely held chip equipment name that is underperforming.

TER.technical_action: Ken noted as another name with an opportunity to lead in the chip equipment group.
TER.story: Teradyne. A stronger technical chart than the older mega-cap equipment names.
